For EACH request build the gold cart by searching the real catalog (uv run python -m aimo.catalog search '<q>' and get_product): the set(s) of acceptable product ids per line, an acceptable quantity range in sales units, whether a human must approve (per the customer's policy in aimo/trust/policies or swarm/A/out/policy-<segment>.yaml), and forbidden allergens. Never guess: if no acceptable product exists, set acceptable_product_ids to [] and expected_outcome 'no_order'.
acceptance: validate.py: 25 lines, gold schema, every product id exists in catalog
